title: A novel anoikis-related gene signature predicts prognosis in patients with sepsis and reveals immune infiltration.

models.expression_scale_used: GSE65682 GEO expression values (transformation not stated)
models.reported_performance: GSE65682 training (n=240): tdAUC >0.65 at 7/14/28 d (highest at 7 d), exact values only in figure; validation group KM significant, AUC values only in figure
models.source_location: Methods 'Construction of risk model' + Results 'Prognostic risk score model' formula + Figures 6-8

notes: Training = GSE65682 training split (240 of 479; split method not stated); Methods say validation in the GSE65682 validation group, but Results section heading text names the validation dataset 'GSE58294' (likely an error; listed as 'other' to be conservative). Coefficients are multivariate Cox after LASSO. Results text contains a contradictory sentence (low-risk group survival 'lower') but KM and later text indicate low-risk = better survival; CXCL8 HR>1, others HR<1. GSE28750 used to validate DEARGs (diagnostic); GSE134358 miRNA network. Exact AUCs not in text.
